project_name: Create a RAG assistant for a
description: Create a RAG assistant for a university advising office that answers policy questions from approved PDF handbooks, cites sources, and escalates uncertain answers to staff.
summary: A medium complexity software application in the software domain.

phases.name: Discovery and Requirements
phases.objective: Define users, scope, core workflows, and MVP boundaries.

tasks.title: Identify users and goals
tasks.description: Document user segments, goals, and success criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Identify users and goals is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Define MVP scope
tasks.description: Prioritize core features and defer nonessential capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Define MVP scope is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

phases.name: Architecture and Design
phases.objective: Design the technical foundation and user experience.

tasks.title: Design data model
tasks.description: Define entities, relationships, and persistence needs.
acceptance_criteria: Design data model is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Design user workflows
tasks.description: Map primary screens or API flows for the MVP.
acceptance_criteria: Design user workflows is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective: Build the MVP features in dependency order.

tasks.title: Build backend foundation
tasks.description: Implement core services, validation, and data access.
acceptance_criteria: Build backend foundation is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Build user-facing workflow
tasks.description: Implement the primary user workflow and connect it to backend services.
acceptance_criteria: Build user-facing workflow is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

phases.name: Testing and Launch
phases.objective: Validate the MVP and prepare a controlled release.

tasks.title: Run functional testing
tasks.description: Test critical workflows, validation rules, and failure paths.
acceptance_criteria: Run functional testing is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

tasks.title: Prepare launch checklist
tasks.description: Confirm deployment, monitoring, documentation, and rollback steps.
acceptance_criteria: Prepare launch checklist is reviewed and accepted by the project lead.

milestones.name: Discovery and Requirements Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Discovery and Requirements are complete and reviewed.

milestones.description: All deliverables for Architecture and Design are complete and reviewed.

milestones.description: All deliverables for Implementation are complete and reviewed.

milestones.name: Testing and Launch Complete
milestones.description: All deliverables for Testing and Launch are complete and reviewed.
